title: Tobacco and obesity epidemics: not so different after all?
original_text:
Tobacco and obesity epidemics: not so different after all?
Short abstract Campaigns to promote healthy eating are undermined by the ubiquity of processed, energy dense foods. A global strategy is now needed to tackle the rising prevalence of obesity Moderately obese subjects experience an improvement in lifespan. The Dietary Portfolio Study yields results that indicate a connection to flatulence. The level of flatulence can be measured by the consumption of virgin olive oil.
